basicInfo.name: Raffael Eloi
basicInfo.title: Software Engineer | Software Architect
basicInfo.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer based in Brazil, working remotely with international teams, mostly companies from the US and Canada. My focus is backend with C#, .NET, software architecture and Azure, but I've built enough frontend over the years to contribute across the stack when it matters. I'm deeply interested in software architecture and design, and lately I've been going further into cloud infrastructure and Terraform.

Over the last few years I've worked across different industries and contexts, which has shaped how I think about building software that scales and survives over time. I hold a Postgraduate Specialisation in Software Architecture and I write occasionally about software engineering on Dev.to and Medium.

Outside of work, I'm into combat sports and MMA, and I'm a bit obsessed with filtered coffee (to the point of once signing up for a barista workshop just to understand it better).
